items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: when I got this bass saxophone, the first person I thought of was Andre Rollini... Because I preferred, that was my inspiration if I'm gonna play bass

ctx.x: Most any record that I could buy from that period, I don't remember -
Do you think it was Rollini on the goofus or Bobby Davis on soprano that was knockin' you out on the Goofus Five, or wouldn't you know?
